title: Deep Neural Network for Visual Stimulus-Based Reaction Time Estimation Using the Periodogram of Single-Trial EEG.
summary: The study reports prediction of measured behavioral reaction times from EEG signals in its experimental dataset. The result is limited to the study paradigm and participants; it does not establish general behavioral prediction or clinical use.
ai_technology: A deep neural network estimated reaction time from periodogram features of single-trial EEG recorded during visual stimulation.
organization: School of Electrical, Computer & Energy Engineering, Arizona State University; University of Texas at Arlington
